findings.finding: Contiguous descriptor and callback entries form a handler-registration family; registration is not proof of callback execution.
The local 0x100 branch can invoke CaptureStart installation; 0x43809ed8 builds callback state through 0x439018b0.
RelMgr constructs 0x3015, 0x3013 and 0x3011 respectively; 0x3011 is sent through 0x43aeaf18 toward queue 0x40193.
Known 0x3011/state-2 row is {0x437fd0e1,0x3011,2,0x3010}; it is an arbitration row and is not the local callback table.
No receiver registration, execution trace, or proven structure conversion from ObjMsg 0x3011/0x3013/0x3015 to local 0x100..0x207 was recovered.
findings.method: literal xrefs, raw pointer search, callback-table tracing

findings.finding: The registered function-pointer slot alone proves neither queue ownership nor runtime execution.
